svg.title: ROV-GND-P4 Rev A — schematic preview
svg.desc: Vector drawing generated directly from the updated KiCad schematic primitives. For engineering use, verify in KiCad; this is not KiCad native export or an ERC certification.

g.text: U1 / P4X CORE: official v3.x 105-pad pin numbering, net labels and power domains
NOTE: physical pad 54 = VDD_HP_1; GPIO54 is pad 98. GPIO35 is BOOT STRAP; shared RMII_TXD1 is NOT validated.
USB CC1/CC2 to DRP controller TBD; VBUS requires protected host/source and sink path.
Header R12: GPIO25 USB_FS_DP; R13: GPIO24 USB_FS_DM. 3.3V GPIO, 5V servo rail.
SD/RADIO CMD+DATA pull-ups (value and voltage domain to verify)
Power decoupling (additional per-pin local capacitors still required on PCB)
REVIEW BEFORE MANUFACTURING: chip revision, boot GPIO35 with Ethernet, PMIC feedback, SD voltage, USB-C DRP, ETH PHY and 50mm routability.
Source-derived SVG preview • verify with native KiCad exporter
